data.description: 词书: KET核心词 - 第9课

text:
[{"word":"both","pronun":"[boʊθ]","translation":"conj. 既…且…
adj. 两个的；两者的
pron. 双方都；两者都
adv. 并；又；两者皆","audio":"both.mp3"},{"word":"bother","pronun":"[ˈbɑːðər]","translation":"n. 麻烦；烦恼
vt. 烦扰，打扰；使……不安；使……恼怒
vi. 操心，麻烦；烦恼","audio":"bother.mp3"},{"word":"bottle","pronun":"[ˈbɑːtl]","translation":"n. 瓶子；一瓶的容量
vt. 控制；把…装入瓶中
vi. （街头艺人演出后）收拢钱币","audio":"bottle.mp3"},{"word":"bottom","pronun":"[ˈbɑːtəm]","translation":"n. 底部；末端；臀部；尽头
adj. 底部的
vt. 装底；测量深浅；查明真相
vi. 到达底部；建立基础","audio":"bottom.mp3"},{"word":"bounce","pronun":"[baʊns]","translation":"n. 跳；弹力；活力
vt. 弹跳；使弹起
vi. 弹跳；弹起，反跳；弹回","audio":"bounce.mp3"},{"word":"bowl","pronun":"[boʊl]","translation":"n. 碗；木球；大酒杯
vt. 投球；旋转；平稳快速移动
vi. 玩保龄球；滑动；平稳快速移动","audio":"bowl.mp3"},{"word":"box","pronun":"[bɑːks]","translation":"n. 箱，盒子；包厢；一拳
vt. 拳击；装…入盒中；打耳光
vi. 拳击","audio":"box.mp3"},{"word":"boy","pronun":"[bɔɪ]","translation":"n. 男孩；男人","audio":"boy.mp3"},{"word":"boyfriend","pronun":"[ˈbɔɪfrend]","translation":"n. 男朋友，情郎","audio":"boyfriend.mp3"},{"word":"brain","pronun":"[breɪn]","translation":"n. 头脑，智力；脑袋
vt. 猛击…的头部","audio":"brain.mp3"},{"word":"brake","pronun":"[breɪk]","translation":"n. 闸，刹车；阻碍
vt. 刹车
vi. 刹车","audio":"brake.mp3"},{"word":"brave","pronun":"[breɪv]","translation":"n. 勇士
adj. 勇敢的；华丽的
vt. 勇敢地面对","audio":"brave.mp3"},{"word":"bread","pronun":"[bred]","translation":"n. 面包；生计
vt. 在…上洒面包屑","audio":"bread.mp3"},{"word":"break","pronun":"[breɪk]","translation":"vi. 打破；折断；弄坏；削弱
vt. （使）破；打破（纪录）；（常指好天气）突变；开始
vi. （嗓音）突变；突破；破晓；（价格）突然下跌
n. 破裂；间断；（持续一段时间的状况的）改变；间歇","audio":"break.mp3"},{"word":"breakfast","pronun":"[ˈbrekfəst]","translation":"n. 早餐；早饭
vt. 为…供应早餐
vi. 吃早餐","audio":"breakfast.mp3"},{"word":"bridge","pronun":"[brɪdʒ]","translation":"n. 桥；桥牌；桥接器；船桥
vt. 架桥；渡过","audio":"bridge.mp3"},{"word":"bright","pronun":"[braɪt]","translation":"n. 车头灯光
adj. 明亮的，鲜明的；聪明的；愉快的
adv. 明亮地；光明地；欢快地","audio":"bright.mp3"},{"word":"brilliant","pronun":"[ˈbrɪliənt]","translation":"adj. 灿烂的，闪耀的；杰出的；有才气的；精彩的，绝妙的","audio":"brilliant.mp3"},{"word":"bring","pronun":"[brɪŋ]","translation":"vt. 带来；促使；引起；使某人处于某种情况或境地","audio":"bring.mp3"},{"word":"broom","pronun":"[bruːm]","translation":"n. 扫帚；金雀花
vt. 扫除
vi. 桩顶开花或开裂","audio":"broom.mp3"}]
